title: Rows That Refuse
description: A good import report doesn't drown you in noise — CsvImportPanel only lists the rows that actually failed, each with its own reason, so a busy admin can act on exactly what needs fixing. Prove that filtering is real.
successCondition: Uploading a CSV with one valid row and two invalid rows (e.g. an unknown customerEmail and a non-numeric weightKg) through the CSV import dropzone on /admin renders exactly two list items under the report, each prefixed "Row N:" with the matching error text — the accepted row never appears in that list, even though it's counted in the Accepted stat tile.
hints: The file input is labelled "Drop a CSV file here, or click to browse" — use it directly rather than simulating a real drag event.
Row numbers are 1-indexed counting the header row, so your first data row is reported as row 2.
